newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Quake jolts Indonesian capital, West Java.
newsitem.headline: Quake jolts Indonesian capital, West Java.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 6.5 on the Richter scale jolted Indonesia's capital Jakarta on Monday but there were no reports of damage or casualties, a Meteorological and Geophysics Department official said.
He said the earthquake struck at 10.54 a.m. (0345 GMT).
The official told Reuters the epicentre was in the Indian Ocean, some 325 km (203 miles) southwest of Jakarta, adding that the earthquake was also felt in the West Java region.
Office workers in Jakarta's central business district said they felt two jolts, but added that there was no damage.
"It was a funny kind of feeling. Things were shaking and moving in my office," one said.
